mechanism_claims.claim_text: Akt phosphorylates Ser158 in BH3BIM(I155R/E158S), converting the designed BH3 peptide from weaker BCL-2/BCL-XL binding to potent antiapoptotic BCL-2-family binding.
mechanism_claims.limitations: BCL-2/BCL-XL binding is a biochemical mechanism context, not an antimicrobial activity assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CPP-BH3BIM(I155R/E158S) reduces viability of Akt-active cancer cells and the effect is diminished when Akt activity is lowered or absent in comparison cell contexts.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CPP-BH3BIM(I155R/E158S) in PC3, HCT116, A549, H1299, and H23 cell assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact OD540 bar heights are figure-derived; final activity rows avoid unsupported exact digitization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The peptide-induced cell death is consistent with intrinsic apoptosis, supported by cytochrome c redistribution, PARP cleavage context, and BAX-dependent viability loss.
